 UP Government Holidays 2027: Uttar Pradesh Releases Holiday Calendar; Check Full List of Public and Restricted Holidays
 By Aishwarya Samant Last Updated: Nov 18, 2026, 12:24 IST Planning your holidays and long weekends in 2027? Uttar Pradesh has released its official holiday calendar, featuring 26 public holidays, 27 restricted holidays and an additional holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. Check the complete month-wise list.
 UP Government Holidays 2027: Uttar Pradesh Releases Holiday Calendar; Check Full List of Public and Restricted Holidays 
 UP Government Holidays 2027: The Uttar Pradesh government has just made it easier for you to plan your trips and long weekends! It has released its 2027 holiday calendar on November 17, 2026, bringing plenty of dates for government employees to mark on their calendars. 
 Issued by Principal Secretary S.B.S. Rangarao, the notification lists 26 public holidays under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, along with 27 restricted holidays. October 15 will be an additional public holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. 
 The calendar also covers bank holidays and local holiday provisions. From major festivals to important commemorative occasions. 
 Lets have a look at month-wise complete UP Government Holiday List 2027
